source_title: BC-621 Reflector Paint for Plastic Scintillators, Saint-Gobain, July 2021
method: Approximate blue-curve pixel medians from the embedded 1567x1025 graph, extracted using Poppler SVG
curve_selection: For the reference wavelength column +/-1 pixel, use median y of curve pixels with B>G+25, G>R+10, 80<B<220
limits: Rounded graph value; no manufacturer measurement uncertainty supplied
Constant R does not reproduce the sharp UV cutoff
Angular law idealized as Lambertian; not a measured BC-621 BRDF
Air-side manufacturer reflectance is an effective proxy, not a calibration of MINE plastic/coating contact
